title: Plan executable P1-001 event-contract verification
businessObjective: Make Phase 1 event-contract implementation executable and independently verifiable without activating event delivery.
technicalObjective: Define the P1-001 normalized system-event contract and exact deterministic validator command, then amend P1-001's packet.
assumptions: P1-001 remains a schema-and-validator task with no live event ingestion, queue, database, or production access.
acceptanceCriteria: A durable design defines a versioned normalized event envelope, required identifiers, type, severity, timestamp, payload boundary, and deterministic invalid-input behavior.
P1-001 is amended to use the exact future command node tests/event-contracts/validate-normalized-system-event-contract.mjs.
Both packets validate and independent review confirms protected paths remain untouched.
solEscalationTriggers: Any live event ingestion, delivery, database, queue, payload containing personal data, or scope beyond static contract design.
rollbackExpectations: Revert only the planning document, P1-001 packet amendment, evidence, and this task packet.
